<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">SDKNativeEngine</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Holds internal services and configurations needed by various HERE SDK modules.
 <p>You can initialize the HERE SDK in two ways:
 <ul>
 <li>Create a shared instance of the <code>SDKNativeEngine</code> with <code>SDKNativeEngine.makeSharedInstance()</code>.</li>
 <li>Create individual instances of the <code>SDKNativeEngine</code> via <code>SDKNativeEngine()</code>. Note that this does not automatically set a shared instance.</li>
 </ul></div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<a id="setAccessKeySecret(java.lang.String)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setAccessKeySecret</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setAccessKeySecret&#8203;(@NonNull
                               java.lang.String&nbsp;accessKeySecret)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Overrides HERE SDK access key secret with new value.
 The new credentials will be used for new requests.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong>
 This method can be called from any thread.
 Access key ID can be set with constructor of SDKNativeEngine.
 New instance of SDKNativeEngine should be used if a new access key ID is required.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>accessKeySecret</code> - <p>New access key secret.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setAccessScope(java.lang.String)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setAccessScope</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setAccessScope&#8203;(@NonNull
                           java.lang.String&nbsp;scope)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Overrides the token scope of the HERE SDK with new value.
 A new token will be fetched with the set scope and used for future requests.
 Setting an empty string will fetch a token for the global scope.
 <p>This method can be called from any thread.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>scope</code> - <p>New scope for token</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="dispose()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>dispose</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;dispose()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Stops pending requests and closes open files and databases .
 Dispose signal is sent to dependent modules.
 Usage of engine, or dependent modules after calling dispose leads to undefined behavior.
 Please be aware that this method does not clean any type of storage.
 <strong>Note:</strong>
 This method should be called from main thread.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="enableUsageStats(boolean)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>enableUsageStats</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;enableUsageStats&#8203;(boolean&nbsp;enabled)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Enable or disable <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-usagestats" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine"><code>UsageStats</code></a> for the HERE SDK. Defaults to disabled (false). When enabled, <code>SDKNativeEngine.getSdkUsageStats()</code>
 returns actual online data consumption. Note that the flag does not cancel pending requests.
 <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-usagestats" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine"><code>UsageStats</code></a> can be enabled or disabled at any time.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>enabled</code> - <p>True, if UsageStats are enabled.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="makeSharedInstance(android.content.Context,com.here.sdk.core.engine.SDKOptions)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>makeSharedInstance</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public static&nbsp;void&nbsp;makeSharedInstance&#8203;(@NonNull
                                      android.content.Context&nbsp;androidContext,
                                      @NonNull
                                      <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sdkoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine">SDKOptions</a>&nbsp;options)
                               throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-instantiationerrorexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.errors">InstantiationErrorException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Makes a new instance of this class using the supplied options and stores it as shared instance
 see <a href="#getSharedInstance()"><code>getSharedInstance()</code></a>. If there was a previously shared instance
 then it's disposed (so there is no need to call <a href="#dispose()"><code>dispose()</code></a> on app side) before the new instance is created.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> The HERE SDK is not guaranteed to be thread safe and it is required to make calls
 to the SDK - including this one - from the main thread.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>androidContext</code> - <p>The Android context</dd>
<dd><code>options</code> - <p>The options for the new engine.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-instantiationerrorexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.errors">InstantiationErrorException</a></code> - <p>Indicates what went wrong when the instantiation was attempted.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<a id="isOfflineMode()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>isOfflineMode</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;boolean&nbsp;isOfflineMode()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the current offline mode.
 <p>Sets offline mode for the HERE SDK to offline or online.
 Defaults to false, which means the HERE SDK uses an online connection.
 When enabled, this prevents the HERE SDK from initiating any online connection except for provided pass through features if set.
 See <a href="#getPassThroughFeatures()"><code>getPassThroughFeatures()</code></a>.
 Note that the flag does not cancel pending requests.
 The mode can be enabled or disabled at any time. In order to fully operate offline, the mode
 needs to be enabled via <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sdkoptions#offlineMode"><code>SDKOptions.offlineMode</code></a>.
 Initialization of the HERE SDK itself does not require an internet connection.
 Returns <code>true</code> if the HERE SDK uses offline connection mode, otherwise returns <code>false</code>.
 <p>Note: This is a <strong>beta</strong> release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The offline mode.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setOfflineMode(boolean)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setOfflineMode</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setOfflineMode&#8203;(boolean&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets the offline mode.
 <p>Sets offline mode for the HERE SDK to offline or online.
 Defaults to false, which means the HERE SDK uses an online connection.
 When enabled, this prevents the HERE SDK from initiating any online connection except for provided pass through features if set.
 See <a href="#getPassThroughFeatures()"><code>getPassThroughFeatures()</code></a>.
 Note that the flag does not cancel pending requests.
 The mode can be enabled or disabled at any time. In order to fully operate offline, the mode
 needs to be enabled via <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sdkoptions#offlineMode"><code>SDKOptions.offlineMode</code></a>.
 Initialization of the HERE SDK itself does not require an internet connection.
 Returns <code>true</code> if the HERE SDK uses offline connection mode, otherwise returns <code>false</code>.
 <p>Note: This is a <strong>beta</strong> release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The offline mode.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getPassThroughFeatures()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getPassThroughFeatures</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.util.Set&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-passthroughfeature" title="enum in com.here.sdk.core.engine">PassThroughFeature</a>&gt;&nbsp;getPassThroughFeatures()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the pass through features.
 <p>Sets pass through features which are allowed to use online data when HERE SDK is in offline mode.
 Pass through features can be updated at any time.
 When offline mode is disabled, existing pass through features will be removed.
 These needs to be set again when you enable offline mode next time.
 By default, reporting of HERE SDK <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-usagestats" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine"><code>UsageStats</code></a> will be enabled when at least one pass-through feature is set.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The pass through features.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.

<a id="getProxySettings()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getProxySettings</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@Nullable
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-proxysettings" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine">ProxySettings</a>&nbsp;getProxySettings()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the current proxy settings.
 <p>Defaults to (<code>null</code>), which indicates proxy is not enabled.
 When setting proxy settings, they will immediately be applied and all the pending and fresh requests will use these settings.
 Pass (<code>null</code>) to indicate that proxy should be disabled.
 If proxy is necessary from the start then it's recommended to use <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-networksettings#proxySettings"><code>NetworkSettings.proxySettings</code></a> in <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sdkoptions#networkSettings"><code>SDKOptions.networkSettings</code></a>.
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Proxy settings of this SDK engine that will be used by HERE SDK network for all requests.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<a id="getSdkUsageStats()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getSdkUsageStats</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-usagestats" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine">UsageStats</a>&gt;&nbsp;getSdkUsageStats()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets a list of usage statistics for all available HERE SDK features.
 <p><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-usagestats" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine"><code>UsageStats</code></a> has cache and persistent storage. Reads from the persistent storage happen on <code>SDKNativeEngine</code> creation step.
 Writes to persistent storage happen by reaching internal limit (amount of upload bytes, by default is 50KB).
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Gets a list of usage statistics for all available HERE SDK features.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
